title: Each one-install replay profile has parts, so a failed install claims only its own defects
why: Lane notes-fix-large-1, 15:22 CST (coordinator ask): under decision mutation-ci-report-and-replay, a failed install of a one-install replay profile claims every defect, not only its own. Closes debt known-defects-install-exposed, which lands with PR #1453.
note: Give each profile (joyous, q_max, mailaudit, degen) parts with code and tests regexes. Unowned until the coordinator starts it. Pick taken in lane replay-profile-parts (coordinator, 15:54 CST): on a failed install, every defect runs. A load-attempt hook (a Python meta-path finder and a Node resolve hook) turns a defect UNKNOWN when its catcher tried to load a missing package. This replaces the static parts for each repo. The hook is built first.
